tab.label: Datasets
tab.title: Datasets
tab.description: Frozen, citable copies of this experiment's data. The experiment itself stays editable.

list.empty: A dataset is a frozen, citable copy of this experiment's data. Publishing one leaves the experiment itself editable.

scope.title: What this dataset will hold
scope.description: The whole experiment is in scope. Readings you exclude in Curate are left out.
scope.readingsDetail_one: Every reading in the experiment, {{count}} so far
scope.readingsDetail_other: Every reading in the experiment, {{count}} so far
scope.dictionaryDetail: Every column the experiment produced, with its description
scope.layoutDetail: The plots and where they sit
scope.studyDetailsDetail: Dates, organism, design, facility and license
scope.versionDetail: This dataset becomes version {{version}}. Earlier versions stay as they were published.

curate.title: Flagged readings
curate.description: Readings flagged on the Data tab or in the app. An excluded reading is left out of the dataset's files and recorded with its reason, and it stays in the experiment.
curate.excludedCount_one: {{count}} reading will be left out of the dataset.
curate.excludedCount_other: {{count}} readings will be left out of the dataset.
curate.none: No readings are flagged, so the dataset holds every reading.

describe.detailsDescription: Prefilled from the experiment. Edit them for this dataset.
describe.authorsDescription: The dataset is cited with its authors in this order. Drag a row to move it.
describe.limitationsHelp: What a reader should know before reusing this data, such as gaps or conditions it does not cover.

license.title: Data license
license.description: Prefilled from the study details. The data is published under this license.
license.cc0Detail: No rights reserved. Anyone may reuse the data without giving credit.
license.ccByDetail: Anyone may reuse the data as long as they credit the authors.
license.metadataNote: The dataset's metadata is always published under CC0, whatever the data license.
license.rightToPublish: I have the right to publish this data under the chosen license.

access.title: Access
access.description: The title, authors and citation are public as soon as the dataset is published. Choose when its files open.
access.openDetail: Anyone can download the files once the dataset is published.
access.embargoedDetail: The files open by themselves on the date, for example when the paper is out.

check.floorDescription: What OpenAIRE, the European open-science catalogue, needs before it harvests the dataset. A missing field blocks freezing.
check.floorBlocked: Fill every OpenAIRE floor field before freezing the dataset.
check.standardsDescription: Each standard warns about what it still lacks and never blocks freezing.

freeze.title: Freeze and deposit
freeze.readings_one: Freezing writes {{count}} reading, counted {{time}}, to files whose bytes never change.
freeze.readings_other: Freezing writes {{count}} readings, counted {{time}}, to files whose bytes never change.
freeze.neverChanges: A published dataset never changes. A mistake found later becomes a new version.

page.notFound: This dataset does not exist or is not published.
page.frozenNotice: This is a frozen dataset of a live experiment, so its files never change. The live experiment itself needs an openJII account.
page.withdrawnFiles: Its files are no longer served. The citation and DOI stay, so existing references still resolve here.

catalogue.title: Datasets
catalogue.description: Every published dataset on openJII, each a frozen, citable copy of an experiment's data.
